description:
Tool for capturing and analyzing logs produced by AudioCodes Session Border Controller (SBC), Media Gateway and IP Phone devices.

Syslog Viewer utility can be used for two major tasks:
- Recording and displaying syslog messages from AudioCodes devices (SBC / Gateway / IP Phones)
- Analyzing recorded logs (including support for interactive SIP Flow Diagram)
- Show remote IP addresses in From / To columns of SIP Flow Diagram (click ⇄ in the column header).
- Make the selected session in SIP Flow Diagram easier to see.
- Open large CSV and Excel exports up to twice as fast, with progress from the start.
- Fix memory growth in long live captures that crashed Syslog Viewer after several hours (regression in v2.50).
- Fix missing Term Reason in SIP Flow Diagram for CSV and Excel exports with device name.
